roadmapSteps: Strengthen mathematics, physics and energy fundamentals.
Study renewable-energy systems and related electrical/mechanical/environmental concepts as offered.
Model or demonstrate a small safe solar/energy-efficiency project under supervision.
Seek exposure to solar, energy auditing, utilities or sustainability projects.
Explore renewable project support, energy-efficiency, testing or further energy study.
